verdict.rationale: Consensus describes itself as having evolved into a built-in research agent that chains citation crawling, DOI lookup, author search and similar-paper discovery. Users can hand off whole literature reviews to Deep Search, and Threads supports conversational follow-up, so research tasks can be delegated inside the product. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of how the agent plans and executes multi-step tasks, evidence of delegating actions beyond search and synthesis (e.g., acting on the library), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
